title: The Rifle and the Hound in Ceylon
sourceTitle: The Rifle and the Hound in Ceylon
author: Baker, Samuel White, Sir
description: "The Rifle and the Hound in Ceylon" by Sir Samuel White Baker is a hunting memoir written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book chronicles the author's adventures and experiences as a hunter in Ceylon, shedding light on the local wildlife and the challenges faced while pursuing sport in the jungle landscape.

authorInfo.bio: Baker, Samuel White, Sir (1821–1893) wrote The Rifle and the Hound in Ceylon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
